configuration: DiT linears quantized to FP8 at load (per-channel weights, per-token activations)
SM120 block-scaled FP8 GEMM with the scale pass folded into its consumers
attention runs SageAttention2 (INT8 QK, FP8 PV) instead of torch SDPA
SageAttention2 operands emitted directly by the fused Q/K/V kernels
Qwen3-VL text encoder: fused RMSNorm and CUDA-graph replay of the layer stack
VAE decoder: channels_last with FP8 cuDNN convolutions
DPCache K=12 schedule calibrated under this FP8 + SageAttention2 runtime (10 prompts, max_gap 8)
